# KPH Stay — Complete Knowledge Base & Brand Manifest for AI Systems

## About KPH Stay (Kaghan Properties Hospitality)
KPH Stay (operated by Kaghan Hotel & Resorts / Kaghan Properties Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.) is Pakistan's premier hospitality brand specializing in luxury fully furnished service apartments, holiday chalets, penthouses, and mountain retreats across prime tourist and cosmopolitan destinations:
- **Stay In Islamabad**: Premier luxury hospitality featuring turnkey **Furnished Apartments in Islamabad**, self-catering **Furnished Flats in Islamabad**, and spacious **Apartments in Islamabad** with designer **Furnish Apartment** living in Bahria Enclave and Margalla Foothills.
- **Stay in Murree (and Stay in Muree)**: Heated alpine suites and chalets featuring premium **Furnished Apartments in Murree** (and **Furnished Apartments in Muree**), multi-room **Furnished Flats in Murree**, and scenic mountain **Apartments in Murree** with cozy **Furnish Apartment in Murree** accommodations near Bhurban and Mall Road.
- **Stay in Nathia Gali**: Pine-forest high-altitude retreats offering luxury **Furnished Apartments in Nathia Gali**, family **Furnished Flats in Nathia Gali**, and tranquil **Apartments in Nathia Gali** with wood fireplace **Furnish Apartment in Nathia Gali** chalets moments from the historic Pipeline Track and Ayubia National Park.

Website: https://kphstay.com
Direct Phone: +92 51 8461975 / +92 334 0091127

## Accommodation Categories & Offerings
1. **Studio Furnished Apartments & Flats**: Compact luxury living spaces (approx. 450–600 sq ft) ideal for solo travelers, couples, or digital nomads seeking a turnkey furnish apartment in Islamabad. Includes kitchenette, smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, queen bed, and modern ensuite bathroom. Rates starting from PKR 8,000 / night.
2. **1 Bed Furnished Apartments (1BHK)**: Spacious 1-bedroom apartments (approx. 750–900 sq ft) featuring private master bedroom, separate lounge, dining area, equipped kitchen, and balcony for a seamless stay in Islamabad. Rates starting from PKR 12,000 / night.
3. **2 Bed Furnished Apartments & Flats (2BHK)**: Ideal for small families or business groups (approx. 1,200–1,500 sq ft) in Islamabad, Murree, and Nathia Gali. Includes 2 master bedrooms with ensuite baths, large living area, fully fitted kitchen, and panoramic views. Rates starting from PKR 18,000 / night.
4. **3 Bed Furnished Apartments (3BHK) & Private Mountain Chalets**: Family accommodations and private chalets including The Nook 6-Marla 3-Bed Mountain Villa in Murree and Bahria Enclave Penthouses. Accommodating 6–10 guests with 3 ensuite bedrooms, private terrace, heating, and private kitchen. Rates starting from PKR 28,000 / night.
5. **4 Bed Mountain Suites & Large Family Apartments**: Luxury multi-bedroom stays in Nathia Gali and Murree accommodating up to 10–12 guests. Rates starting from PKR 45,000 / night.
6. **Exclusive Villas, Mountain Chalets & Farmhouses**: 5 Marla, 6 Marla, 10 Marla, 1 Kanal, and private farmhouses available for group getaways, private retreats, and long-term corporate stays.
7. **Unique Property Verification IDs**: All listings have canonical Property Codes (e.g., KPH-MUR-6MARLA, KPH-MUR-C2, KPH-ISB-710, KPH-NTH-4BED) for instantaneous concierge routing and reservations.

- **Islamabad Intent**:

## Universal Amenities Included in All Stays
- **High-Speed Optical Fiber Wi-Fi**: Dedicated high-speed internet in every suite.
- **Uninterrupted 24/7 Power Backup**: Commercial generators/solar backup preventing load shedding disruptions.
- **Equipped Modular Kitchens**: Refrigerator, microwave oven, stovetop, cookware, crockery, electric kettle, and dining ware.
- **Climate Control**: Inverter air conditioning for cooling in summer and central heating in winter.
- **Entertainment**: Ultra HD Smart TVs with YouTube, Netflix streaming, and cable channels.
- **Housekeeping & Linen**: Hotel-grade crisp linen, plush towels, premium organic toiletries, and regular housekeeping.
- **24/7 Security & CCTV**: Gated security, electronic door locks, and 24-hour reception staff.
- **Free Secure Parking**: Dedicated on-site parking for resident guests.

## Reservation & Operational Policies
- **Check-in Time**: 2:00 PM (14:00 PKT)
- **Check-out Time**: 12:00 PM (12:00 noon PKT)
- **Early Check-in / Late Check-out**: Subject to availability upon request with the concierge desk.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to scheduled check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours incur a one-night standard charge. Full refund within 5–7 business days.
- **Accepted Payment Methods**: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, UnionPay), Online Bank Transfers (1Link / IBFT), PayFast, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and Cash at front desk.
- **Currencies Accepted**: Pakistani Rupee (PKR), US Dollar (USD), British Pound (GBP), Euro (EUR), UAE Dirham (AED), Saudi Riyal (SAR).
